rows.value: MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline (OpenGWAS ukb-b)
rows.quote: The BC datasets from three large-scale studies, ieu-b-4874, ukb-b-8193, and FinnGen_R11_C3_BLADDER_EXALL, were used as the outcome variables, respectively.
rows.coder_note: Step 2 of the decision order (C4 first case): the accession ukb-b-8193 carries the prefix ukb-b that the row 'MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline (OpenGWAS ukb-b)' lists, and nothing conflicts: European ancestry and 1101 cases plus 461,832 controls (a trait-specific N below the row's 463,005, rule H) are allowed by that row. The results passages write the third dataset as ukb-d-C67; ukb-d is listed by the same dictionary row, so it points to no other row.
